messages.subject: inla function error
parts:
Hi, every time I try to run a simple model as

res <- inla(formula,
            data = inla.stack.data(stk.full),
            control.predictor = list(
              compute = TRUE,
              A = inla.stack.A(stk.full)
            )
)


I get this error.. It' been days and Idk how to fix this. 


/Library/Frameworks/R.framework/Versions/4.0/Resources/library/INLA/bin/mac/64bit/inla.run: line 115: /Library/Frameworks/R.framework/Versions/4.0/Resources/library/INLA/bin/mac/64bit/inla: No such file or directory
/Library/Frameworks/R.framework/Versions/4.0/Resources/library/INLA/bin/mac/64bit/inla.run: line 115: exec: /Library/Frameworks/R.framework/Versions/4.0/Resources/library/INLA/bin/mac/64bit/inla: cannot execute: No such file or directory

 *** inla.core.safe:  The inla program failed, but will rerun in case better initial values may help. try=1/1
/Library/Frameworks/R.framework/Versions/4.0/Resources/library/INLA/bin/mac/64bit/inla.run: line 115: /Library/Frameworks/R.framework/Versions/4.0/Resources/library/INLA/bin/mac/64bit/inla: No such file or directory
/Library/Frameworks/R.framework/Versions/4.0/Resources/library/INLA/bin/mac/64bit/inla.run: line 115: exec: /Library/Frameworks/R.framework/Versions/4.0/Resources/library/INLA/bin/mac/64bit/inla: cannot execute: No such file or directory
Error in inla.core.safe(formula = formula, family = family, contrasts = contrasts,  :
  The inla-program exited with an error. Unless you interupted it yourself, please rerun with verbose=TRUE and check the output carefully.
  If this does not help, please contact the developers at <he...@r-inla.org>.
The inla program failed and the maximum number of tries has been reached.

Thanks in advance.

Valentina Monte

messages.author: 3eab71733027a24a
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] inla function error
parts:
Your installation of INLA failed in the sense that it is incomplete. maybe you
need to set

options(timeout=99999)

to avoid timeout in the download. however, running R-4.0 is waaaay to old, and
you need to go to R-4.3 to get the newer INLA package, R-4.0 is no longer
supported
